title: Rectangular bar
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a rectangular loop made up of four lines. The first line runs from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), the second line extends from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0625), the third line goes from (0.75, 0.0625) to (0.0, 0.0625), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by drawing from (0.0, 0.0625) back to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.004 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional rectangular bar. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Integrate the part by creating a new solid body with the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar are length 0.7500000000000001, width 0.06250000000000001, and height 0.004000125000000001.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.004)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
